verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs state that AI agents can interact with Drata to "automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language" (drata-docs-2), and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented (drata-probe-4). Natural-language operation therefore works by connecting an external AI agent or client over MCP; there is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface, and the claim is vendor-only. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works in practice.
